lines.text: The LORD reigns, robed in majesty and clothed and armed with strength.
The world is firmly established and cannot be moved, and the LORD's throne was established long ago.
The writer tells the LORD that the nations have risen and the rivers have raised their voice.
The LORD is majestic out of the whirlwind, above the roar of many waters.
The LORD's testimonies are fully confirmed, and holiness adorns His house for all the days to come.
